whatItDoes.text: We provide a demo "pen-in-holder" task that illustrates the core idea in ReKep. Below we provide several options to run the demo.

requirements.text: Obtain an OpenAI API key and set it up as an environment variable:

(Optional) Consistency Cost: If closed-loop replanning is desired, we find it helpful to include a consistency cost in the solver to encourage the new solution to be close to the previous one (more details can be found in the paper appendix).

(Optional) Grasp Metric or Grasp Detector: We include a cost that encourages top-down grasp pose in this codebase, in addition to the collision avoidance cost and the ReKep constraint (for identifying grasp keypoint), which collectively identify the 6 DoF grasp pose.
